_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-ldo sim harness (issue #2).
family            sky130 PDK family (via ciel, the maintained successor to
volare -- same open_pdks build format and CLI shape; volare's
release feed stopped Aug 2025. Pin moved volare->ciel by
DR-015 / issue #767)
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal stack)
open_pdks_commit  the open_pdks build hash every record is pinned against
install_command   reproduces this exact install
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if neither $PDK_ROOT nor `ciel path` resolve
ngspice_lib       the combined ngspice model-library include, relative to the variant dir
xschem_pdk_rc     the PDK's own xschemrc, relative to the variant dir
process_corners   the MOS/BJT/resistor-skew corner sections that actually exist in
ngspice_lib -- verified against the .lib sections of
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice for this pinned commit. Same
pin as sky130-bandgap (2AMLogic/sky130-bandgap), so this list is
reused unmodified: tt/ss/ff/sf/fs are the standard MOS corners,
ll/hh are the resistor/capacitor-only skew corners. Additional
sections (hl/lh, the *_mm mismatch sections, mc Monte Carlo)
exist in the library and can be added here once an experiment
manifest actually needs them.
tools             the ngspice/xschem versions this harness is tested against (issue
#291), declared the way open_pdks_commit declares the PDK. Each
value is the version token parsed from `ngspice -v` / `xschem
--version`. A mismatch is a named WARN from --check-env and a
FAIL under --require-pdk; it never changes a measurement gate.
install_command: pip install ciel==2.6.1 && ciel enable --pdk-family sky130 -l sky130_fd_pr f6eeac7dad085ffcc829ccfd721f7b4ce39edcf7
